Development/Piloting of Participatory Budgeting Programs in select municipalities.Development/Piloting of Citizen Budgets Developed in select municipalities.Development/Introduction of Indicative Job Descriptions for public employees at the local level.Implementation of Training Programs for a select number of positions within the MoLG as well as within local government.tries. The programme relies on the institutional capacities and structures of the five countries, by ensuring their ownership.The programming of the 7th phase of CADAP has allowed to develop a revised version of the logical framework built on the achievements and lessons learnt of its previous phases, having in mind the present context in which the programme will operate.
